question: Which of the following organisations announced in June 2020 that it will host its next summit in Davos in January 2021 under the theme ‘The Great Reset?
solution:
The correct answer is __**World Economic Forum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** 51st ****World Economic Forum summit** will be held in **Davos** in January 2021.
 
• **The theme** of the summit will be **"The Great Reset."**
 
• The meeting will be conducted in both** virtual **and **personal **forms, **connecting global governmental and business leaders in around 400 cities**.

The **agenda of the initiative **is –

 
• The world must act jointly and swiftly to revamp all aspects of our societies and economies, from education to social contracts and working conditions.
 
• Every country must participate, and every industry, from oil and gas to tech, must be transformed. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Former name—European**** Management Forum.**
 
• **Founded - 1971 **by **Klaus Schwname was**
 
• The name changed to World Economic Forum in **1987**.
 
• **Next Summit** -**2022**
